replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Yep, hubs aren't working right now. I just do /where a, and see where someone named "a____" is, so I go to that certain game. Just keep doing that until you find where a decent amount of players are, and join that game.

If there is nobody online that has a username which starts with "A", continue to "B", and so on and so forth.
